# bare-posix

POSIX-specific bindings for Bare.

```
npm i bare-posix
```

## API

#### `posix.getgid()`

#### `posix.setgid(id)`

#### `posix.getegid()`

#### `posix.setegid(id)`

#### `posix.getuid()`

#### `posix.setuid(id)`

#### `posix.geteuid()`

#### `posix.seteuid(id)`

#### `posix.getgroups()`

#### `posix.getgrnam(name)`

#### `posix.getpwnam(name)`
